pricing.heroHeadline: Simple pricing that scales with your team.
pricing.heroSubtitle: Start for free. Upgrade when you need more projects, more teammates, or enterprise-grade controls.
pricing.starterDescription: For individuals trying AAP on a single project.
pricing.teamDescription: For growing teams managing several applications.
pricing.enterpriseDescription: For organizations with advanced security and compliance needs.
pricing.faq1A: Yes — upgrade or downgrade at any time from your organization settings. Changes are prorated for the current billing period.
pricing.faq2Q: What happens when I hit a plan limit?
pricing.faq2A: You'll be notified before you hit a limit. Existing projects and connections keep working — you just won't be able to add more until you upgrade.
pricing.faq3Q: Is my database credential data secure?
pricing.faq3A: Connection credentials are encrypted at rest, and AAP connects read-only by default. See our security page for details.
pricing.faq4Q: Do you offer discounts for annual billing?
pricing.faq4A: Yes — annual billing saves 20% compared to paying monthly, on the Team plan.
pricing.faq5A: Enterprise pricing is based on team size and deployment needs. Contact sales for a quote tailored to your organization.
